summary.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 桌面端内置服务应用请求，并让已知运行错误保留具体类型。
summary.en-US: Fixes built-in Service App requests on Windows Desktop and preserves classified runtime errors.

body.zh-CN: 收藏和日历可在 Windows 安装版、直接运行版和便携版中使用 NextClaw 自带运行时完成数据读写。
body.en-US: Favorites and Calendar complete data reads and writes with the runtime shipped by NextClaw in Windows installed, unpacked, and portable editions.

body.zh-CN: 已知的服务应用运行错误会保留具体错误类型，不再一律显示通用重试提示。
body.en-US: Known Service App runtime errors retain their specific error type instead of always appearing as a generic retry prompt.
